description: Shared test vectors for the naming convention (ADR-0020, US03.01, US03.02): inputs and the exact names that
infra/modules/naming/naming.bicep computes for them. Two suites read this one file, so the Bicep module and its
TypeScript ports cannot drift: infra/tests/check-naming.py (evaluates naming.bicep with `bicep snapshot` and
compares every name) and portal/shared/test/naming.test.ts and tools/platform-cli/test/naming-vectors.test.ts
(compare the names each port computes). Hash parts (h6, h5, h6 of the platform registry and portal database) are
Bicep uniqueString values for the placeholder subscription IDs; a ported function that needs one takes the vector's
full name of its target as input. Fictional Contoso names and placeholder GUIDs only.
When naming.bicep changes on purpose, review the change and regenerate `names` with:

description: Injectivity of the per-app names (ADR-0052, app availability isolation): two apps of one environment with confusable
inputs (a hyphen moved, a hyphen dropped, slugs equal in their first 16 compact characters; hosts x-y.zone and x.y.zone)
must get different names, or one app's deployment could write the other's resource. check-naming.py evaluates each pair
with naming.bicep and fails when the set of names that collide differs from `collisions` (both ways, so the list stays
true). Inputs override `base`. `independent` names don't depend on the slug or the host (instance or environment
names, the fixed test title); `knownNonInjective` says why each function may collide and what keeps the apps apart.

The last pair is two environments, for the Entra uniqueName's incarnation suffix (ADR-0061): with a single hyphen orders in nonprod with incarnation 1 and orders-nonprod in an environment named i1 would share the registration contoso-orders-nonprod-i1; the suffix --i{n} keeps them apart (a slug never contains --).

knownNonInjective.slugCompact: An input to other names only (registry, app vault, storage account), never a resource name on its own: each of those adds h6, the hash of the app resource group name, which is injective.
knownNonInjective.actionGroupShortName: The action group's short display name in alert mails (12 characters), not an identity: the action group resource is ag-{slug}-{env} in the app resource group.
knownNonInjective.frontDoorCustomDomain: cd-{host with dots replaced by hyphens} in the environment's shared Front Door profile. Not renamed: a rename re-creates every existing domain and its validation (downtime). `platform validate app` rejects two apps of one environment whose hosts give the same name (check front-door-domain-name).

pairs.label: incarnation suffix (two environments: orders in nonprod, incarnation 1 / orders-nonprod in an environment named i1)
